author: PlayStation
description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/overwatch/

Brace yourself for the biggest Hero drop in Overwatch history! 

Jetpack Cat, Anran, Mizuki, Emre, and Domina step into the spotlight all at once bringing new playstyles, new dynamics, and new voices into the fray. 

Emre and Anran heat up the Damage Role, Mizuki and Jetpack Cat bring plenty of heals to the Support Role, and Domina dominates as our newest Tank Hero. 

Join all 5 new Heroes and choose your side in the battle between Overwatch and Talon when Season 1: Conquest starts Feb 10. 

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games #overwatch
title: Overwatch - Season 1: Conquest: 5 New Heroes Gameplay Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games

author: PlayStation
description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013958

Led by the mysterious Dr. Mercurius, the DBS Lab seeks a way to save the world by salvaging Shards of Possibility from the dangerous Sea of Possibility.

Yet as the research team dives deeper, they begin to suffer from a strange phenomenon known as memory influx.

Why does every lab member involved in the project witness scenes that feel eerily familiar? What is the true cost of uncovering the world’s hidden truth? And, who is ultimately responsible for its impending destruction of this world?

Perhaps the answers will only be revealed with the full release of BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X.

Coming to PlayStation 5 February 12th!

#ps5 #ps5games #blazblueentropyeffect
title: BlazBlue Entropy Effect X - Story Trailer | PS5 Games

State of Play broadcasts live February 12 at 2pm PT / 5pm ET / 11pm CEST | February 13 at 7am JST on YouTube and Twitch, and will be broadcast in English with Japanese subtitles also available. We’ll see you then!
